name: 27401 · Greensboro, NC
findings: ZIP 27401 (Greensboro) has 222 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27401 (Greensboro) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27401 (Greensboro) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 52 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
